title: Outstandingly Oven Roasted Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery, molten, one-pot Algerian dish featuring lamb and unique ingredients, this recipe is a low-fat friendly twist on traditional tagine, using a tandoor style oven roasted method and incorporating a mars bar for sweetness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, prunes, and chopped mars bar, and stir to combine.
Cover the dutch oven with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
